cases.name: append-only
cases.note: real bytes, real proof, nothing tampered with

cases.name: append-only-1024
cases.note: AN HONEST PAIR AT A POWER OF TWO. The blind spot costs the ACCUSATION and never the verification: the fold completes here

cases.name: damaged-proof
cases.note: AN HONEST LOG with one proof node zeroed. Convicting here is the failure this whole project is about

cases.name: damaged-proof-1024
cases.note: the same damage at a power of two — beside rewrite-2048 it shows a transport fault and a structural ceiling wearing the same reason

cases.name: malformed-root
cases.note: AN HONEST LOG whose presented root lost one character in transit — 63 hex, not 64. The most likely real failure a stranger will ever hit, and the class that walked past every gate in this repo

cases.name: zero-growth-malformed
cases.note: GPT'S CASE, EXACTLY. Same size, no fold, and a presented root damaged in transport. The demonstrator answered OBSERVATION_CONFLICT here — an innocent log accused because an envelope was torn

cases.name: zero-growth-conflict
cases.note: same size, WELL-FORMED roots that differ. This one is a real conflict and the accusation is earned — the case that must keep firing after the malformed guard lands

cases.name: zero-growth-conflict-1024
cases.note: AND THE CASE THAT CORRECTS THE BLIND-SPOT STORY: a power-of-two retained size that CAN accuse. The ceiling is a property of the FOLD SEED, and at zero growth there is no fold

cases.name: encoding-exponent
cases.note: REAL CHAIN BYTES, honest in every way, with the retained treeSize written 1e3 instead of 1000. Python reads a float and refuses; JavaScript reads the integer 1000 and returns APPEND_ONLY. One file, one side clears it, the other will not look

cases.name: encoding-bignum
cases.note: A CLOSED SPLIT, KEPT AS A REGRESSION. Retained 2^53+1, presented 2^53. It used to accuse in JavaScript — the retained size rounded down to 2^53, m became equal to n, and two differing roots at one size read as a conflict. core/aura-consistency.ts now refuses at Number.isSafeInteger, so both readers say UNDETERMINED. It stays because a class that closed is a class that can reopen. The roots are NOT chain readings: this case is about the reader, not the record

cases.name: rewrite-2047
cases.note: leaf 500 forged and the log extended; 2047 is not a power of two, so the conflict is derivable

cases.name: rewrite-2048
cases.note: THE SAME FORGERY, retained one leaf later. 2048 is a power of two AND the tree grew: the retained root is the fold seed, so no conflict is derivable

expectedDemonstratorVerdictIs: What minimal/verify.py should return for this case. Equal to measuredVerdict everywhere EXCEPT declared splits, where the two readers disagree by design — read this field rather than measuredVerdict if you are checking the demonstrator.
whatMeasuredVerdictIs: What core/aura-consistency.ts returned when this case was generated. It is one implementation answering, recorded — not an oracle and not a ground truth.
whichNumberIsTheClaim: honestLogsAccused over honestLogs is the false-accusation rate and it is the stronger claim: it includes the transport-damaged and malformed cases, which are exactly where a verifier is most likely to convict an innocent log. casesExpectingAppendOnly is the smaller set where a clean pass is the correct answer, and it is not the same question.
whyAgreementIsNotProof: When minimal/verify.py returns the same verdict, that is CROSS-IMPLEMENTATION AGREEMENT. All the implementations descend from one rule: it was written for the membrane, the spec encodes it, and the Python was built from the spec. Agreement bounds implementation error. It does not bound whether the rule is right, and a shared misreading produces identical answers in all of them.
